newsitem.title: USA: Reuters to split TIBCO unit into two units.
newsitem.headline: Reuters to split TIBCO unit into two units.

text.p: Reuters Holdings Plc said on Thursday that it is splitting its wholly owned software subsidiary, TIBCO, into two separate units.
A new unit to be called TIBCO Software Inc has been created to market its software products and its systems integration expertise to industries outside the financial arena.
A second unit, to be called TIBCO Finance Inc, will continue to provide products and services to the financial sector.
About 100 of the 400 employees, as well as the assets of the TIBCO business not associated with financial products, are being transferred to TIBCO Software, it said.
TIBCO President and Chief Executive Vivek Ranadive will assume the same post in both units, which will operate within the group as independently managed subsidiaries.
The company said that employees will be granted stock options in TIBCO Software.
TIBCO is based in Palo Alto, California, and was previously named Teknekron Systems Inc. It was acquired by Reuters in 1994.
